message.content: {"basis": "The 'Units Sold by Product' dashboard shows Product E as the leftmost bar. Its height is visibly just above the 10,000 gridline and well below the 20,000 gridline, placing its value in the 10,000-12,500 range. According to the 'Merchandising policy levels' table, values between 8,000 and 12,500 units map to the 'Low-sales review queue activation level'. This corresponds to the option 'Route Product E to low-sales review queue'." , "option_label": "Route Product E to low-sales review queue"}
